info.title: APK20 Public API
info.description: Public REST surface for the apk20.com catalog + download flow. The Catalog tag covers browse / search / app-detail endpoints used by the Next.js site. The Download tag covers token minting and HMAC-signed file serving. Admin-only mutations on the catalog surface are marked with a padlock and require HTTP Basic credentials in production.

post.description: Rate-limited by client IP (10 / 10 min). Verifies the requested variant exists on disk, triggering an on-demand Google Play Delivery fetch on miss. With async=true a miss answers 202 with a jobId to poll at GET /api/token/jobs/{jobId}; otherwise the request waits for the build. post.summary: Full-text search across apps
post.description: POST-only, bot-blocked, and limited to 20 distinct searches per IP per 10 minutes. Repeating the same query with different filters is a refinement and draws on a separate budget of 120 refinements per IP per 10 minutes, so using the filter panel does not spend the distinct-search allowance. The response carries facet counts alongside the results so a filter panel can be rendered without a second round trip. Every filter field is optional; omitting one leaves that dimension unfiltered, so a body carrying only query/page/size/catId/type/sort/free behaves exactly as it did before faceting existed.

200.description: Paginated AppSummaryDto list plus facet counts
